name: Abnormal Security - Overview
description: The Abnormal Security - Overview dashboard in Sumo Logic provides a comprehensive summary of email threats, highlighting total threats, phishing and malware attacks, and trends over time. It categorizes threats by type, vector, and attack party, and tracks the severity and progression of cases. This dashboard helps security teams quickly identify and respond to email security incidents effectively.
title: Abnormal Security - Overview

panels.title: Untitled
panels.text:
Filters: 

###attack_type:  It indicates the type of attack.
###attack_vector: It describes the method used for the attack.
###attack_strategy: It specifies the strategy employed by the attacker.
###attack_party: It identifies the target of the attack.
###auto_remediated: It indicates whether the threat was automatically remediated.
###post_remediated: It represents whether the threat was remediated after the fact.
